latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Reciprocity Strategy Designer skill.

- Enables design of reciprocity-based persuasion strategies, including gift and concession reciprocation.
- Helps detect when reciprocity tactics are being used against you, supporting defensive strategies.
- Provides structured guidance for use in marketing, sales, negotiation, and outreach scenarios.
- Covers lead magnets, free value offers, concession-based selling, door-in-the-face, and more.
- Suitable for both creating influence and resisting unwanted reciprocal obligations.
